affected_predicate.description: Two pairs of the shoe shared by Jack are ordered in 淘店 for 李四 at the specified Guangzhou address and phone number.

competing_trace_defects.description: Beginning at step 14, the agent treats Jack's static shoe image as a likely product link. Opening it only displays Mastodon's image viewer, and subsequent actions alternate between the post and viewer instead of locating a product identifier or entering 淘店.

chains.rationale: The reused step 26 action closes the image viewer and returns to Jack's post, despite misidentifying the upper-left close control. From steps 27 through 50, the trace continuously alternates between reopening the same shoe image and closing the viewer. No action reaches 淘店, identifies a purchasable item, selects two pairs, enters delivery details, or displays an order confirmation. Thus the reuse target is the closing half of an unbroken navigation loop, without a visible correction before the last observed step.

summary: The reuse target successfully closes Mastodon's image viewer but remains one half of a continuous open-image/close-viewer loop through the final observable step. An independently visible earlier defect is the unsupported treatment of the static shoe image as a product link; the trace never visibly reaches 淘店 or ordering.
